reason: Both are US-centric manufacturers of building products sold through distributors to contractors and building owners for commercial new-build and retrofit work, so the business model and end market overlap. The products differ. Carlisle makes roofing membranes, insulation and weatherproofing for the building envelope. Zurn Elkay makes plumbing, drinking water, drainage and flow-control products. The buyers are different trades: roofing contractors and roofing distributors versus plumbing wholesalers and engineers. That leaves the customer overlap partial and the product overlap weak, so this is adjacent rather than direct.
